text: Personal statement explains your reasons for applying, preparation for the field, career plans and relevant background.
Curriculum vitae summarises your education, work and internship experience, projects and achievements.
Official transcripts verify your academic record and must show grades for all courses taken.
Official degree certificate or expected graduation letter confirms award or expected completion of your bachelor degree.
At least two referee reports are required through the online application system.
Only submitted applications with the S$109 application fee paid by the deadline will be processed.
English proficiency proof such as TOEFL or IELTS is required if your previous university education was not mainly taught in English. 雅思 托福 语言成绩.
GRE, GMAT or GATE scores are not mandatory according to current programme notes, but are useful supporting evidence if available.
